messages:
Jordan: Hey folks, posting here because my chronic migraines have flared up again. Bright office lights and late-night on-call shifts are a big trigger. I9m requesting accommodations: dimmer/private lighting + tinted eyewear, no night on-call for ~8 weeks, and a temporary reduction in recurring meetings between 2
m-10am PT. Not mandatory to share medical paperwork right away but I can provide a short note if needed.

Marco (Manager): Sorry you9re going through this, Jordan. Totally fine to start with temporary changes. We9ll cover on-call nights; can you list which dates you need removed from the rota? Also I can push some recurring meetings to asynchronous updates or record notes.

Jordan: Thanks Marco. Need nights removed for the next 8 weeks starting Mon Apr 14 (so Apr 14

pr 14

pr 14

pr 14 ok that9s messy
ut basically Apr 14

pr 14

pr 14

pr 14). Sorry typo: I meant Apr 14 to Jun 9. Prefer not to do any shifts that start after 8pm local. Meetings: anything before 10am my time (PDT) causes issues; I can do async updates or shift meeting time to later when feasible.

Lena (People Ops): Hi Jordan 609 4ac Thanks for flagging. We can open an accommodations intake immediately and implement interim measures while we review. Quick checklist: 1)	Upload supporting note if you have one (not required to start) 2)	Confirm whether you need full-day remote or just reduced meeting windows 3)	Tell us which on-call weeks/dates to reassign. We9ll log this as a temporary accommodation for 8 weeks and schedule a 3-week check-in.

Jordan: I uploaded a short note to the intake form just now. I9d like to remain onsite sometimes but need dim lighting and the tinted clip-on lenses, plus no shifts after 8pm. Meetings before 10am should be optional.

Priya: I can take Jordan9s night slots for those 8 weeks. @Marco if you9re cool with that I9ll update rota.

Marco (Manager): That9s great, Priya 60a Thanks for volunteering. Priya, please coordinate with David on escalation handoff.

Facilities: We can provide a low-glare desk lamp, a monitor hood, and tinted clip-on lenses. We can also reserve a dimmable focus room on 2C for afternoon quiet work. Jordan, want us to set up a permanent desk lamp and test the lamp intensity with you?

Jordan: Lamp + clip-ons sound perfect. Please reserve 2C daily 1
pm-5pm for quiet work and set the desk lamp at the dimmest comfortable setting. Thank you.

Lena (People Ops): Action items: Facilities to prepare desk lamp + clip-ons and reserve 2C daily 1
pm-5pm (assigned to Facilities); Priya to cover night on-call Apr 14 oD Jun 9 (assigned to Priya/Marco); People Ops to document intake and schedule check-in on May 5 (assigned to Lena). We9ll also mark meetings before 10am optional for Jordan and encourage asynchronous updates.

Accom Bot: Reminder: accommodations intake received for Jordan (ID #A-4721). Next review in 3 weeks.

Jordan: Uploaded the note, thanks everyone. I appreciate the quick turn-around on this.

Priya: On-call rota updated and calendar invites sent for swapped shifts.

Facilities: Desk lamp installed and clip-ons dropped at Jordan9s desk. Room 2C reserved daily 1
pm-5pm through Jun 9.

Marco (Manager): I9ve updated the team meeting cadence to limit Jordan9s early calls; please ping me if a meeting absolutely needs to be before 10am and we9ll figure a one-off.

Lena (People Ops): Logged in HRIS and marked temporary accomodation (8 weeks). Check-in scheduled May 5 10am PT with Jordan + Marco. If needs persist we9ll extend as appropriate.

Jordan: Thank you all. If things worsen I9ll flag earlier. Appreciate the support. :white_check_mark:
